tickets.title: Coordinate Retirement Plan Rollover
tickets.text: Use this workflow when Dana Wrenpuddle is evaluating a rollover from an employer retirement plan to an IRA or another eligible plan. Confirm objectives, compare available options, document recommendations, and track transfer completion without using client-specific account numbers in the template. Compare keeping the former Cloudberry Kite Design 401(k) (about $412,000, including $58,000 Roth and $354,000 pre-tax), moving it to the Silver Marmot Analytics plan, or rolling eligible assets to an IRA, covering Roth money, investment menus, fees, and Dana's preference for no more than two primary investment accounts outside checking and savings.

subTasks.title: Gather plan and account details
subTasks.text: Request current plan statement, investment menu, fee disclosures, distribution paperwork, and any employer separation or plan eligibility details from Dana Wrenpuddle.

subTasks.title: Analyze rollover alternatives
subTasks.text: Compare keeping assets in the current plan, rolling to a new employer plan, rolling to an IRA, or taking other permissible action. Include fees, services, creditor protection considerations, investment access, and tax implications.

subTasks.title: Prepare recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Draft a concise summary of the recommended path, required client decisions, anticipated transfer method, and any cautions for advisor review.

subTasks.title: Track transfer and confirm investment plan
subTasks.text: After client authorization, monitor rollover status, confirm receipt of funds, and coordinate reinvestment according to the approved allocation.

tickets.evidence: Dana asked to compare keeping the former 401(k), moving it to the new plan, or rolling eligible assets to an IRA, covering Roth money, menus, fees, and simplicity; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-29.

tickets.title: Obtain Silver Marmot Analytics Benefits Packet
tickets.text: Obtain the Silver Marmot Analytics benefits packet for Dana Wrenpuddle while enrollment is open so the new employer plan options can be reviewed. Dana is now product operations director at Silver Marmot Analytics with a $168,000 base salary and 18% target annual bonus.
tickets.evidence: The Silver Marmot Analytics benefits packet is still needed by 2024-03-22 while enrollment is open.

tickets.title: Review 401(k) Deferral Percentage for Dana Wrenpuddle
tickets.text: Review the old Cloudberry Kite Design 401(k) deferral percentage against Dana Wrenpuddle's $168,000 base salary and 18% target bonus at Silver Marmot Analytics to confirm the same annual savings level, especially if bonus deferrals are separate.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review of Dana’s prior pay stub and stated salary found the old 401(k) deferral percentage may not produce the same annual savings level, especially if bonus deferrals are separate; follow-up is needed by 2024-04-05.
